resources.string: Show phone status on your computer
Your computer shows your battery, signal and sound mode while it is connected.

The battery level, whether the phone is charging and whether battery saver is on, the signal bars, mobile network and carrier name, the Wi-Fi bars, the ringer mode and Do Not Disturb. Nothing that tells where you are: no Wi-Fi network names and no cell location. link2linux needs no permission for this.
